title: Premium savings interest policy
text: Premium savings accounts earn tiered interest. Balances above 10,000 earn 3.1 percent APY. Interest accrues daily and is credited monthly. Accounts falling below the minimum balance for 30 days revert to the standard rate.

title: Mortgage pre-approval checklist
text: Mortgage pre-approval requires two years of income statements, recent bank statements, credit report authorization and proof of down payment. Pre-approval is valid for 90 days. The debt-to-income ratio must not exceed 43 percent.

title: Card dispute procedure
text: Members may dispute unauthorized card transactions within 60 days of the statement date. Provisional credit is issued within 10 business days while the investigation proceeds. Chargeback reason codes must be recorded on the case.

title: Wire transfer cutoff
text: Domestic wires submitted before 3 PM Eastern settle the same business day. International wires require the beneficiary SWIFT code and purpose of payment. Wires above 50,000 need dual approval.
